title: White House registers aliens.gov

tellings.quote:
know if you saw this, but uh the White
House just registered aliens.gov, gov,

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels mentions, almost in passing, that the White House has registered the web address aliens.gov, which uses the .gov ending reserved for US government websites. He brings it up in an episode with a former head of the National Security Agency, the US spy agency that intercepts communications. He doesn't say when it happened or what the site is for, but he treats it as a hint that the government may be getting ready to say something about aliens.
